svg.title: Four verdicts from one evidence archive
svg.desc: The same sealed archive of three files passes a verifier four times. Intact archive: verified, exit 0. One byte changed: the seal is broken and the verifier stops it: failed, exit 2. A required file missing: the verifier stops it: not-established, exit 3. A changed verifier: the route forks through the old and the changed verifier and both say verified, exit 0, and both records are kept.
